# rok-data

> PostgreSQL data tooling for Rust, consolidated from the rok ecosystem
> (rok-db, rok-fluent, rok-orm, rok-sqlc): one runtime (`rok-data-core` +
> derives via the `rok-data` facade), two generators, one CLI (`rok`,
> published as `rok-data-cli`). The schema directory is the only source
> of truth; `rok init` and `rok gen` turn it into a Rust data layer and
> actix-web or axum API features. Rust ≥ 1.94, PostgreSQL 12+.

## Start here

- [Docs map](README.md): what every file under docs/ is for, and the paste-to-agent conventions.
- [rok-data overview](overview.md): what rok-data is, its crates at a glance, its scope vs. the rok family's sibling project, and the rok-cli/rok-data-cli naming trap.
- [Installation](installation.md): `cargo install rok-data-cli` (binary `rok`), `cargo add rok-data`, platform notes.
- [Getting started](getting-started.md): the front door (`rok init`, `rok gen`, staged migration pairs, CI drift check), the monorepo template (`rok init --template monorepo --org`: api, web, desktop and mobile Apps on generated TS/Dart/Rust clients), the runtime by hand, the legacy generators.

## For agents

- [rok-data for coding agents](coding-agents.md): the machine contracts — `--json` shapes (`StatusRow`), exit codes, the unattended schema-change loop, the repo's agent skills.
- [CLI reference](cli-reference.md): every `rok` command, flag, output and exit code; contract text matching the crates' grammars.
- [Engineering-skill config](agents/issue-tracker.md): where the engineering skills read and write tickets (local markdown in `.scratch/`), the triage labels (`agents/triage-labels.md`) and the domain-docs layout (`agents/domain.md`).
- Agent skills (in-repo): `.agents/skills/rok-data/`, `rok-data-init/`, `rok-data-models/`, `rok-data-migrations/`, `rok-data-sqlc/`, `rok-data-docs-site/` — each a `SKILL.md` with triggering descriptions.

## Reference

- [Workspace architecture](architecture.md): crate responsibilities, the four dependency rules, migration-system layers, generated-code markers.
- [Feature matrix](feature-matrix.md): every capability mapped from the four source repositories, with the old→new CLI command table.
- [Pagination](pagination.md): `paginate`/`simple_paginate`/cursors/chunking/streaming and the JSON wire shapes.
- [Validating input](validation.md): `#[derive(Input)]`, field and database rules, context, nesting, messages, the 422 body, JSON Schema.
- [Migrating to rok-data](migration-guide.md): per-repository notes (rok-db, rok-sqlc, rok-fluent, rok-orm) and the 0.9.0 / 0.8.0 / 0.7.0 / 0.6.0 / 0.5.0 / 0.4.0 / 0.3.0 upgrades.
- [Benchmarks](benchmarks.md): the `Expr`/`Select` builder-effort bench, honestly scoped.

## Records (history; read, don't rewrite)

- [Migration audit](migration-audit.md): what the four source repositories held before consolidation.
- [Migration plan](migration-plan.md): the original consolidation plan.
- [Unified pipeline plan](unified-pipeline-plan.md): the 0.2.0 pipeline plan — schema-dir truth, front door, templates.
- [Workspace ADRs](decisions/0001-runtime-lineage.md): deliberate cross-crate decisions, 0001–0034 (see the directory `docs/decisions/` for all); the latest, [0034](decisions/0034-rok-dev-runs-the-stack.md), adds rok-dev, which runs a project's stack (`rok dev`, `rok run`, `rok doctor`, `rok port`).
- [Engine specs](specs/0.3.0-model-shaped-data-layer.md): per-release specs (0.4.0 everyday verbs, sqlc absorption, input validation, 0.5.0 production templates) under `docs/specs/`.
- [Desktop starter spec](specs/desktop-starter.md): the monorepo's desktop App (ADR 0031) on `clients/rust`: sign-up, the keychain session, My account, and the users screens for an admin.
- [gRPC template spec](specs/grpc-api-template.md): gRPC as a third API framework (`framework = "grpc"`, engine ADR 0028): a `.proto` and a tonic service per Resource over the same service trait, and the `grpc-api` Template (workspace ADR 0030).
- [Schema editing spec](specs/schema-editing.md): `rok schema column add|remove|change|rename` edit the schema dir in place and record renames for the next migration; every command takes a JSON payload through `-j` (inline, a path, `@path` or stdin).
- [Starter feedback spec](specs/starter-feedback.md): the rok side of a project's first build on the Monorepo template — CI installs the `rok` release, `-w` for a Template's API App, Modules left out with `--without` (ADR 0033), one design-token source, and a first-run local setup.
- [rok dev spec](specs/rok-dev.md): rok-dev starts a project's Runnables from `rok.toml`'s `[dev]` tables, owns its children, waits on readiness, applies migrations, boots the device and passes the API address it needs (ADR 0034).
- [Toolchain split runbook](https://github.com/ateeq1999/rok-workspace/blob/main/docs/plan.md): the PowerShell + `gh` steps that split rok-data into member repos (ADR 0032): backups, the `rok-workspace` meta-repo, `rok-templates` out, `rok-v2` owning `rok`.
- [Toasty patterns research](research/toasty-patterns.md): the study behind With-loading's shape.

## Nearby (root)

- `../README.md` — project front page, install and quick start.
- `../CHANGELOG.md` — every release's notes; a tag without its `## [X.Y.Z]` section fails.
- `../GLOSSARY.md` (+ `GLOSSARY-MAP.md`) — the project's language.
- `../AGENTS.md` — working rules for agents in this repository.
- `../crates/rok-data-sqlc/docs/` — the engine's own ADRs (engine ADR 0028 newest) and guides.
- `rok-templates/docs/guide/` (its own repository, https://github.com/ateeq1999/rok-templates/blob/main/docs/guide) — the templates' guide: the monorepo template (`monorepo.md`: its Apps, the one contract, the clients, the `rok gen` loop, what is hidden), the API's parts (accounts, files, jobs, observability, security, AWS) and recipes (Sentry, OTLP metrics, Redis rate limit, webhooks, OIDC, FCM push notifications).
